title: I built my first playable ecology trap for an AI-assisted solo game
author: Ok_Injury9275
selftext:
I’ve been working on a solo game called **UnderBloom**.

The idea is that you start in a mostly barren desert and descend into a much denser living world below it.

This is the first small playable thing I’ve finished that I wanted to show. It’s an amber trap tree. Most of these trees are harmless, but some have an amber lure inside the lower branches. If you get too close, the branches close around you.

I’m using AI a lot while making the game, mostly for coding, concept art, iteration, and helping me prototype things faster in Unity.

I’m trying to make the dangerous parts of the world more about noticing how organisms behave instead of just fighting enemies.

Still very early, but I’m curious if the trap reads well in the video or if the amber makes it too obvious.
